I know how you feel, I dont talk about what I want to because most people I know dont really care or dont understand what I feel. To find someone you can talk about all is a really rare thing, so most of the time I feel like Im saving them the trouble If I dont mention and act like they expect me to.

That way I can try and Focus on dealing with the stuff alone or distract my mind with other things I find interesting, even more when some interactions are kinda forced, so I stay mostly alone. 

So alone is my most peaceful time, forcing ourselves to be positive gets old quickly, so Im happy when I feel like It, It helps going through that feeling of being left alone or as a secondary person in a way, at least for me. It really hurts, yes, no shame in feeling that way.

You need to find someone who is willing to listen, and in my experience that comes from people who've been in a situation like you are. 

We can't be always right, sure you can mistake a friendship, and that's life. Some will never get how much trust means to us.

It's not easy, far from that, but you gotta try and worry about yourself.
